fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor (inlined in the fighter boma builder near 0x710068a52c) stores vptr 0x7104f8a0e0; the base/other class 0x7104f74058 (72 bytes) is built the same way near 0x71005796d4.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the BattleObjectModuleAccessor here (same register then stored at boma+0x90); every method reaches LinkModule via [+0x8]+0xD0, WorkModule via [+0x8]+0x50, StatusModule via [+0x8]+0x40.

fields.name: hit_stop_real_frame
fields.evidence: get_hit_stop_real_frame slot (vtable +0xC8, f_71004df680) returns the u32 here. set_hit_stop_frame (vtable +0xD0, f_71004df690) writes frame, raised to hit_stop_frame_fix if that is larger; update (f_71004df490) decrements it and clears is_hit at 0; cancel_hit_stop and the stop-release path zero it.

fields.name: hit_stop_frame_fix
fields.evidence: set_hit_stop_frame_fix (vtable +0xD8; base f_71004df710, fighter f_71006ebba0) stores its int arg here. Acts as a minimum: set_hit_stop_frame, set_other_stop and the deferred-other-stop path use it if larger than the requested frame, then clear it (64-bit zero of +0x14/+0x18).

fields.name: hit_stop_frame_fix_life
fields.how: computed: fighter only, set from WorkModule param int (vtable +0x250) with hash40 0x06e5ec7051 ('common') / 0x1a99c94c70 (unlabelled)
fields.evidence: Fighter set_hit_stop_frame_fix f_71006ebba0 stores frame at +0x14 and the param result at +0x18; fighter update f_71006ebb20 decrements +0x18 and clears +0x14 when it reaches 0 (fix value expires). Zeroed by cancel_hit_stop.

fields.name: other_stop_frame[STOP_OTHER_KIND_NORMAL]
fields.evidence: get_other_stop (vtable +0x58, f_71004df340) loads u32 at +0x1C+12*kind. STOP_OTHER_KIND_NORMAL=0, FINISH_CAMERA=1, NUM=2 (lua_const). set_other_stop (f_71004df270) writes it (never lowering), update decrements it.

fields.name: other_stop_pending_frame[NORMAL]
fields.evidence: set_other_stop stores the frame here instead of applying it when a global phase value ([[[0x71052C33D8]]] u32) is <= 3; update f_71004df490 applies a non-zero pending value (sets frame, active, is_other, starts stop) then zeroes it. cancel_other_stop zeroes it with the frame (64-bit store).

fields.name: other_stop_active[NORMAL]
fields.evidence: Set to 1 when an other-stop is applied, cleared by cancel_other_stop and by update when the frame reaches 0; refresh f_71004df840 ORs it with +0x30 and is_hit to decide whether the object stays stopped.

fields.name: other_stop_frame[STOP_OTHER_KIND_FINISH_CAMERA]
fields.evidence: Same array, kind 1 (+0x1C+12). Update decrements it and clears +0x30 at 0.

fields.name: other_stop_pending_frame[FINISH_CAMERA]
fields.evidence: Second pending slot handled by update f_71004df490 exactly like +0x20.

fields.name: other_stop_active[FINISH_CAMERA]
fields.evidence: Set with the kind-1 frame, cleared when it expires, by cancel_other_stop(1) and end_stop.

fields.name: item_stop_frame
fields.evidence: get_item_stop (vtable +0x70, f_71004df3b0) returns u32 here. Written by vtable +0xF8 (base f_71004df7e0, fighter f_71006ebc70), reached from set_item_stop; decremented by update, is_item cleared at 0; cancel_item_stop zeroes +0x34/+0x38.

fields.name: item_stop_pending_frame
fields.evidence: set_item_stop (f_71004df370) stores the frame here when the global phase value is <= 3 (else applies it now via +0xF8); update applies and zeroes it.

fields.name: is_stop
fields.evidence: is_stop (vtable +0x88, f_71004df410) returns this byte. Set to 1 on every stop start (followed by LinkModule vtable +0x540(0,0)); cleared by refresh f_71004df840 when no stop source remains (then LinkModule +0x548(0) and StatusModule vtable +0xD8(0, was_damage)).

fields.name: is_hit
fields.evidence: is_hit (vtable +0x98, f_71004df430). Set by set_hit_stop_frame, cleared by cancel_hit_stop and when hit_stop_real_frame reaches 0.

fields.name: is_damage
fields.evidence: is_damage (vtable +0xA0, f_71004df440). set_hit_stop_frame stores its bool arg here; refresh passes it to StatusModule +0xD8 and clears it when the stop ends.

fields.name: is_item
fields.evidence: is_item (vtable +0xB0, f_71004df470). Set with item_stop_frame, cleared by cancel_item_stop and when item_stop_frame reaches 0.

fields.name: link_stop
fields.evidence: set_link_stop export calls vtable +0x80 (f_71004df3e0, not in dossier) which stores arg1&1 here (skipped while +0x43 is set). Update asks LinkModule +0xF0 (is_valid_link_stop) while it is set and calls set_link_stop(false,false) when invalid; refresh counts it as a stop source.

fields.name: link_stop_arg2
fields.evidence: set_link_stop second bool (arg2&1). Unexported vtable +0xA8 (f_71004df450) returns link_stop && this byte.

fields.name: is_special_stop
fields.evidence: is_special_stop (vtable +0x90, f_71004df420). set_special_stop export calls vtable +0xE0 (f_71004df720) which stores arg&1 here then refreshes.

fields.name: in_link_notify (reentrancy guard)
fields.evidence: Set to 1 around every LinkModule +0x540/+0x548 call and cleared after; set_link_stop does nothing while it is set.

fields.name: is_other
fields.evidence: is_other (vtable +0xB8, f_71004df480). Set when any other-stop is applied; update clears it when both other-stop frames are 0.

fields.name: fighter_link_release_timer
fields.evidence: Fighter class only. Fighter update f_71006ebb20 decrements it (when the global freeze flag is clear); on reaching 0 while not stopped it calls LinkModule +0x548(0x18). Fighter cancel_hit_stop/end_stop do the same call early and zero it. No writer of a non-zero value found in this module (set from elsewhere).

fields.name: fighter_item_stop_facial_set
fields.evidence: Fighter item stop (f_71006ebc70) ORs 0x400 into WorkModule int FIGHTER_INSTANCE_WORK_ID_INT_FACIAL_FLAG (0x100000a3) and sets this byte; fighter refresh f_71006ebd50 clears the bit and the byte once is_item is false.

notes: Fighter class 0x7104f8a0e0 (80 B) = base 0x7104f74058 (72 B) + 0x48 timer and 0x4C flag; base ctor zeroes 0x10..0x44, fighter ctor also 0x48/0x4C; 0x31-0x33 and 0x45-0x47 padding. The vtables were read from the dump with rtti.Names().word. Null slots: set_hit_stop_frame=+0xD0 f_71004df690, set_link_stop=+0x80 f_71004df3e0, set_special_stop=+0xE0 f_71004df720. Also +0xC0 per-frame update (base f_71004df490, fighter f_71006ebb20 then base), +0x100 refresh-stop (f_71004df840 / fighter f_71006ebd50), +0xF0 f_71004df760 (starts a stop after checking is_stop and LinkModule +0xF8). Countdowns are frozen while global byte [[0x71052B8558]+0x58] is set, and that byte also keeps is_stop on. end_stop zeroes everything from 0x10 to 0x44 without calling LinkModule (the fighter version first sends +0x548(0x18) if timer 0x48 >= 1). boma+0xD0 = LinkModule (dossier), +0x50 WorkModule, +0x40 StatusModule (assumed).
